_note: Per L farm. yield is what a farm makes a month on average; it comes in whole harvests every growMonths (a month is a game day): yield × growMonths × (1 + the long-grow bonus), the bonus rising from 0 at longGrowBonus.fromMonths to longGrowBonus.max at toMonths (src/sim/food.ts). A farm short of staff, power or water gives a smaller harvest, not a later one. Replaces the farm's rawFood output and its water and power use; makes, when given, is the resource it yields instead of rawFood (non-food crops sit at the long end). Each edible crop is its own food type for meal variety (data/food.json).
